main_results: exact attainable fixed-(n,m,b) joint adaptive/fixed frontier at every feasible adaptive depth

claim_firewalls.CA: C_A is minimax guaranteed complexity, not fitness or the uniquely evolved policy.
claim_firewalls.robust_expected: Robust value is frequency-free/statewise; expected value additionally depends on branch frequencies and completion profiles.
claim_firewalls.comparator: All adaptive-versus-fixed claims use the declared universal fixed comparator unless another comparator is modeled explicitly.
claim_firewalls.Aedes: Chandel Figure 3a is an aggregate temporal-effect anchor; Uehara Figure 2D/S2 supplies one-minute interval-censored individual first-probe profiles. Neither is a fitness or adaptive/fixed validation.
claim_firewalls.prior_art: Sequential VOI, deadline-weighted utility, adaptivity gaps, tree flattening, prior-weighted expected depth and costly sensory fidelity are not novelty claims.
claim_firewalls.expected_value_prior_art: Prior-weighted expected decision trees and skewed shallow-branch advantages are established; expected-value ceilings are supporting biology, not a fourth novelty theorem.
claim_firewalls.fixed_resolver: Minimum/generalized fixed test-collection problems are established prior art; novelty is not claimed for C_F by itself.
claim_firewalls.flattening: Adaptive-tree flattening into all internal queries is established query-complexity reasoning; novelty is restricted to the sharp fixed-(n,m,b) joint frontier and its biological lift/inverse.
